caseName: Dep't of Homeland Sec. v. Regents of the Univ. of Cal.
caseNameFull: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY v. REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari in No. 18-587 granted. Petition for writ of certiorari before judgment in No. 18-588 and No. 18-589 granted. The case is consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
